C-MUYA-CURRENT-MODEL-EXPORT.Name: Export the current Muya model after render-only document changes
C-MUYA-CURRENT-MODEL-EXPORT.Summary: Make the existing exportStyledHTML and exportHtml public methods capture the complete current model through getMarkdown at call entry, so a render-only tab/history import cannot export the previously active document. Preserve the renderer export pipeline, formatting options, signatures and read-only behavior.
C-MUYA-CURRENT-MODEL-EXPORT.Problem: On Export PR #233 head 170ce81c641bc296a7ee481b957f76a7367a8d75, a native inactive-tab PDF has the intended tab filename but the previous active tab's content. Two failing-first cases with real Muya confirm the mechanism independently: setMarkdown with renderOnly updates ContentState, getMarkdown returns the selected document, but both export APIs read the stale this.markdown field. That field is refreshed by dispatchChange, which render-only imports deliberately avoid. The Muya source is identical on current main 9912f7fbba95dfb4244fe53f930c690a19a5c0bc; this bounded dependency repair can be governed and verified on that clean main baseline. The original Export plan does not authorize writing this Muya file.

Goals.R-1: Both existing HTML export entry points obtain one current complete-model Markdown string synchronously when the method is called and pass that captured string to the existing ExportHtml instance. A later document change during asynchronous conversion cannot change this operation's source string.
Goals.R-2: Export remains a read: no dispatchChange, new history item, dirty/save revision, cursor mutation or assignment to the cached markdown field is added to refresh the snapshot. Existing arguments and return types remain unchanged.
Goals.R-3: Real-Muya regressions prove selected-document content after render-only imports, parity for ordinary current content, and a stable snapshot when a later model change occurs during asynchronous export. Verification distinguishes source content from save-dialog filenames.

Constraints.Item: Runtime writes are limited to src/muya/lib/index.js and its existing public export helpers, contract/map/change-summary documentation. Use the existing complete-model getMarkdown serializer and ExportHtml implementation; no new dependencies.

Synchronize only M-012 and V-M-012 in the routed runtime graph/verification documents, and add tests/renderer/muya/export-current-model.test.js. Existing approved plans, assertions and frozen archives remain immutable.

Keep load/import, renderOnly, progressive mounting, history, dirty tracking, native IPC, export options, filename selection, settings storage and release/signing behavior unchanged. Existing thresholds, retries, skips and timeout policy are not relaxed.

Owner approval of this specification authorizes planning only. Implementation requires the completed matching approved plan. Source review, final commands and exact-candidate hosted checks precede integration and lifecycle decisions.

NonGoals.Item: Global synchronization or removal of Muya's markdown cache, or changing dispatchChange/setMarkdown/history behavior.
Redesigning renderer operation ownership, exporting a different document after its initiating owner is invalidated, changing native commands, or changing export formatting and image embedding.
Repairing the separate image replacement failure, settings persistence, signing boundaries, versions, tags, releases or other audit groups.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Before the runtime fix, the new real-Muya selected-document cases fail on wrong output content. After the fix, both APIs export only the selected complete model after render-only load, without the preceding document marker.
Export captures the source string once at method entry and preserves it across the existing asynchronous exporter. Ordinary same-document output remains equivalent for the same model/options.

Focused export and Markdown round-trip suites pass. Tests prove no new change event or history/cursor mutation is introduced by obtaining the export snapshot. Existing renderer build, IPC typing and hosted coverage/matrix gates pass without relaxed floors or skips.

After this dependency is integrated into the Export feature candidate, strengthen its already-authorized browser oracles to inspect PDF/HTML payloads and Word document.xml, then verify native inactive-tab outputs on a fresh source/binary-bound artifact. Filename-only evidence is insufficient. Preserve owner/platform verdicts separately.

Current-state graph/verification, local contracts and evidence agree. Complete final assertions and required checks on the delivered candidate; archive only after explicit lifecycle authorization. Test applications and executable copies are closed and deleted after each completed run.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Use real Muya and the existing exporter for failing-first selected-content checks; any async snapshot seam must be inert, must not replace the model-selection decision and must not provide a false native IPC claim. Measure leaf command budgets before approving the execution plan; full hosted/browser/native work belongs to acceptance. Preserve the native wrong-buffer PDF and the original two failing probe results as evidence.

Approval.ApprovalScope: Draft specification only; no implementation or lifecycle authorization.
